timeoutPrompts: Junia: Hello? Steam wand is hissing, did you say something?
Junia: Did your connection cut out? Can you hear me?
Junia: Don't fall asleep on me during closing shift!
Junia: Line must be dead. Talk soon.

nodes.partnerDialogue: Junia: Hey! The grinder is finally off. Just wiping down the espresso group heads. What are you up to?

choices.choiceText: Just waiting to hear about that Ethiopian roast.
Working late, running entirely on caffeine.
Wishing I was at the café instead.

nodes.partnerDialogue: Junia: It turned out incredible! Cupped it twenty minutes ago—crisp citrus and floral notes all through the finish.

choices.choiceText: Save me a bag of beans from this batch.
You really know your craft, Junia.

nodes.partnerDialogue: Junia: Don't overdo it past sunset! Swap to chamomile or mint, or you won't sleep a wink tonight.

choices.choiceText: Only if you brew it for me tomorrow.

nodes.partnerDialogue: Junia: Flattery noted! Maybe I'll keep the corner booth open for you tomorrow morning.

choices.choiceText: I'll be the first one in line.

nodes.partnerDialogue: Junia: Already labeled with your name on the shelf behind the bar. Rest up, {PlayerName}!
